decisions.reason: Automatic wrapping in the Indstilling left-side text boxes does not change the separate fixed-margin behavior required beneath the Vejledning short-description section.
Text wrapping and column containment do not change how interactive-field placeholder text must be cleared on activation.
Automatic word wrapping may reduce reliance on manual line breaks, but it does not alter the required spacing behavior when hard returns are used in continuous text.
The source change concerns automatic wrapping in Indstilling text boxes, not the independent requirement for ordinary multiline entry beneath Item and Title in the Board Seminar template.
Column overflow containment does not change bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, variants, or approved appearance.
Automatic wrapping in Indstilling does not change the Board Meeting alignment relationship among Item and Title, Topic, Proposal, and Start time.
The source change does not affect the separate Board Meeting behavior governing borders created when a line is added after a Topic.
Text-box wrapping does not alter the calendar-style date selector or its applicable document contexts.
The source change does not alter the requested walkthrough or explanation of how Master template tables function.
Column overflow containment has no effect on which theme colors are included or exposed as choices.

The candidate governs table and right-column stability during content pasting, while the source change adds automatic wrapping for left-side Indstilling text boxes when typed content exhausts available room; it does not modify the candidate's paste-specific state.
Text wrapping and column containment do not change first-page footer visibility or the page on which numbering begins.
